spec.definitions: def rational_comparison : Prop := ∀ (a b c d : ℚ), 0 < b → 0 < d → (a / b < c / d ↔ a * d < c * b)
spec.proof:

  intro a b c d hb hd
  exact (div_lt_div_iff₀ hb hd)
